name: Pixiv FANBOX
summary: Pixiv's official creator patronage hub supporting tens of thousands of anime illustrators, game devs, and R-18 artists directly.
ranking_rationale: Seamless integration inside Pixiv artists' profiles; weighed against stricter visa/mastercard merchant guidelines ban hyper-real 3d & select tags.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Seamless integration inside Pixiv artists' profiles
Clean multi-tier fan pledges delivering PSDs, uncensored sets & early builds
cons: Stricter Visa/Mastercard merchant guidelines ban hyper-real 3D & select tags
Less built-in external browse discovery than Patreon
